Lapatinib and conjugated synthetic estrogens: Lapatinib increases the levels or effects of conjugated synthetic estrogens by influencing hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporters. As a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor, lenacapavir may increase the risk of adverse reactions with CYP3A4 substrates for up to 9 months after the last subcutaneous dose. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 4. Levofloxacin and conjugated synthetic estrogens: Levofloxacin decreases the levels or effects of conjugated synthetic estrogens by altering intestinal flora.
